author: /root/fresh29_workflows
premortem: A family map is mistaken for leaf parity or proposed tasks for executed usability, silently expanding implementation or clearing exposure HOLDs.
blast_radius: Scratch review artifacts only; no product code, tests, authority or shared generated files edited.
detection: Explicit authored-only statuses, zero observation/test counts, family/leaf distinction, exact current-authority and approved-design bindings; structural source checks recorded.
rollback: Do not adopt these scratch artifacts; retain source evidence and existing authority unchanged.
stop_conditions: Artifact contradicts current authority or approved design
A task requires unapproved capability or owner semantics
A claimed observation lacks real participant and owner evidence
A preservation recommendation implies second writer or different tenancy
remaining_holds: Complete versioned Foundry leaf inventory and acceptance evidence
Independent consolidated review of authored artifacts
Actual first-slice browser and representative-user acceptance
Exact approved test SHA and named boundary RED admission for implementation
